document.title: Operator Health Check — 2026-03-12 06:51 UTC
document.content:
# Operator Health Check

## Summary
- Overall status: degraded
- PM2: 12 online, 1 stopped
- Docker: most containers up, 2 unhealthy
- Disk: root at 69% used
- RAM: 11.3 GB / 27.5 GB used (~41%)
- GPU: RTX 4090 healthy, 20.55 GB / 24.56 GB VRAM in use by VLLM::EngineCore
- OpenClaw gateway: reachable on 127.0.0.1:18789, but service status output is inconsistent and service config is out of date

## PM2
Online: agent-log, gpu-router, iam-chat-proxy, kira-admin, kira-app, kira-dashboard, oopuo-website, openclaw-bridge, openclaw-gateway, stella-tax, whatsapp-bridge, zenithcred-website
Stopped: whisper

## Docker
Healthy/Up: iam-web-3007, scribe-service, nextjs-server, neo4j-server, iam-ghost, iam-mysql, lidaros-backend-1, inventree stack, langfuse postgres/redis/minio, omiximo-bridge, evolution_api, evolution_postgres, ollama, n8n, kali-osint
Unhealthy: lidaros-frontend-1, omiximo-email-automation
Notable: langfuse_langfuse-web_1 had just restarted and was up for less than a second at check time

## Resources
- Disk: /dev/sda1 452G used / 210G available (69%)
- RAM: 11351 MB used / 27532 MB total
- Swap: disabled
- GPU temp/power normal: 40C, 20W idle-state power profile

## Gateway
- Probe target responding at ws://127.0.0.1:18789
- Service layer reports: stopped/inactive, last exit 203
- Service unit warning: embedded OPENCLAW_GATEWAY_TOKEN, config looks out of date or non-standard
- Multiple gateway-like user services detected, which increases risk of drift/confusion

## Recommended follow-up
1. Investigate whisper failure before restarting blindly
2. Check healthcheck/logs for lidaros-frontend-1 and omiximo-email-automation
3. Clean up OpenClaw gateway service state and reinstall service unit if systemd-managed gateway is intended
